name: clean_range
query:
find Work, Year
where
  year_created(Work, Year)
  Year between @1968 and @1972

name: disjoint_join
query:
find Work
where
  created_by(Work, A)
  interviewee(Work, B)

name: unsatisfiable_comparison
query:
find Work
where
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y between @1992 and @1997

name: contradictory_negation
query:
find Work
where
  made_at(Work, oval_house)
  not
    made_at(Work, oval_house)

name: role_names_reversed
query:
find Artist, Work
where
  created_by(Artist, Work)

name: count_query
query:
find Artist, count(Work)
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y > @2090
